components.name: Central Action Board
components.notes: Materials Yard, Commission Market, Guild Hall, Canal Wharf, Magistrate's Hall (2 spaces) and the Imperial Recognition track.
components.notesZh: 印有泥柴场、瓷牙行、陶工行、漕运码头、州衙（2个工位）与御府声望轨。

components.name: Shared Kiln Board
components.notes: Eight spaces: 3 High (+1), 3 Middle (0), 2 Low (−1). Cover spaces by player count.
components.notesZh: 8个窑位：高温区3个（+1）、中温区3个（0）、低温区2个（−1）。按人数盖住部分窑位。

components.name: Kiln Player Boards
components.notes: Ru, Guan, Ge, Ding and Jun. Each shows its Kiln Tradition, a Form & Decorate with 2 spaces (the second added by learning a Form & Decorate Tech), a Glaze & Load with 2 spaces (the second added by learning a Glazing & Loading Tech), 3 Tech slots and an Imperial Kiln area.
components.notesZh: 汝窑、官窑、哥窑、定窑、钧窑各1块。每块印有该窑口的传承能力、制坯饰纹（2个工位，第二工位待添设）、施釉装窑（2个工位，第二工位待添设）、3个技艺位与御窑区。

components.name: Shifu Workers
components.notes: One per player colour.
components.notesZh: 每种颜色1名。

components.name: Apprentice Workers
components.notes: Three per player.
components.notesZh: 每种颜色3名。

components.name: Heat markers
components.notes: One per player colour; faces +1 and −1.
components.notesZh: 每种颜色1个；一面+1，一面−1。

components.name: Clay
components.notes: Resource.
components.notesZh: 资源。

components.name: Wood
components.notes: Resource and firing fuel.
components.notesZh: 资源，也是烧窑的燃料。

components.name: Coins
components.notes: Decoration, Advanced Tech and Magistrate's Hall currency.
components.notesZh: 用于支付纹饰、技艺与州衙费用的货币。

components.name: Vessel Cards
components.notes: Ten each: Bowl, Plate, Brush Washer, Vase and Censer.
components.notesZh: 碗、盘、笔洗、瓶、香炉各10张。

components.name: Main Order Cards
components.notes: One unified public/reservable deck; see Appendix A.
components.notesZh: 统一的公开／可承接牌堆；见附录A。

components.name: Starting Order Cards
components.notes: Separate easy opening deck; never shuffled into the Main Order deck.
components.notesZh: 单独的开局委托牌堆，永不洗入主委托牌堆。

components.name: Advanced Tech tiles
components.notes: Six Form & Decorate, six Glazing & Loading, six Firing. The Kiln Master tile comes with its own marker.
components.notesZh: 坯作、釉作、火作各6张。窑工一牌附带窑工标。

components.name: Kiln Contribution Cards
components.notes: Three per player: Bank, Tend, Stoke.
components.notesZh: 每人3张：压火、守火、添柴。

components.name: Imperial Recognition Markers
components.notes: One per player colour.
components.notesZh: 每种颜色1个。

components.name: Imperial Kiln Tiles
components.notes: One-space private kiln tiles; gained at Imperial Recognition 2.
components.notesZh: 单格的私人窑板块，御府声望达到2时获得。

components.name: Imperial Priority Tokens
components.notes: One per player colour; begin on Recognition space 3 and are taken when that player reaches it.
components.notesZh: 每种颜色1个；开局放在声望轨第3格，该玩家到达时取走。

components.name: Cover tokens
components.notes: Physical prototype only: two per player; each covers the second space of a personal action until the matching Tech removes it. The digital game has no such token; it shows a second space as not yet added.
components.notesZh: 仅实体原型使用：每人2个，盖住两个第二工位，习得相应门类的技艺后移去。数字版没有此配件，只显示第二工位尚未添设。

components.name: VP Markers / Score Pad
components.notes: Use a score track or paper.
components.notesZh: 使用计分轨或计分纸均可。

components.name: First Player Marker
components.notes: Passes clockwise each round.
components.notesZh: 每轮顺时针传递。

components.name: Round Marker
components.notes: Tracks rounds 1–5.
components.notesZh: 记录第1–5轮。

components.name: Kiln Die
components.notes: Six-sided, faces 1, 1, 2, 2, 3, 3. Rolled at the start of each round for the starting Base Heat. Prototype with an ordinary die: 1–2 = 1, 3–4 = 2, 5–6 = 3.
components.notesZh: 六面骰，点数为1、1、2、2、3、3。每轮开工时掷出，作为基础火候的起点。原型可用普通骰子代替：1–2算作1，3–4算作2，5–6算作3。

components.name: Crackle markers
components.notes: Used by the Ge Kiln only. A marked ceramic keeps its marker until delivered or exhibited.
components.notesZh: 仅哥窑使用。带有开片标的器物一直保留此标，直到交付或陈列。
